# Trace-Distill-Repair MVP 实验计划
# 核心假设: 结构化 trace 分段 + teacher 打分产生的压缩 trace 在修复任务上优于行级过滤

experiments:
  - plan_id: mvp_trace_collect
    name: "BugsInPy trace 收集 + 结构化分段"
    hypothesis: "≥80% BugsInPy 实例可成功收集 trace 并解析为结构化 segments"
    type: data_preparation
    dependencies: []
    dataset: "40 BugsInPy 实例"
    method:
      trace_collection: "sys.settrace (Python 3.12+)"
      structural_segmentation: "解析 call subtrees / loop groups / exception chains"
    pass_criteria: "≥32/40 实例成功收集 trace + 解析为结构化 segments"
    kill_criteria: ">40% 解析失败 → 终止"
    status: IN_PROGRESS

  - plan_id: mvp_teacher_scoring
    name: "Teacher 打分验证"
    hypothesis: "DeepSeek-V4-Flash 对 structural segments 的 keep/drop 标注 precision ≥ 0.6"
    type: evaluation
    dependencies: [mvp_trace_collect]
    method:
      teacher_model: "DeepSeek-V4-Flash"
      task: "对 structural / line-level segments 分别标注 keep/drop"
      sample_size: 50
    pass_criteria: "抽查 50 segments, precision ≥ 0.6"
    kill_criteria: "precision < 0.5 → 换 teacher 或终止"
    status: BLOCKED

  - plan_id: mvp_repair_comparison
    name: "4 条件修复对比"
    hypothesis: "structural-filtered trace 在 >2K token 子集中 win rate > 50%"
    type: experiment
    dependencies: [mvp_trace_collect, mvp_teacher_scoring]
    method:
      repair_model: "DeepSeek-V4-Pro"
      conditions:
        - no-trace
        - full-trace
        - structural-filtered
        - line-filtered
      subset: ">2K token trace 实例"
    pass_criteria: "structural win rate > 50% (p<0.15 directional signal) + 5 case 定性分析"
    kill_criteria: "structural win rate ≤ 50% → 终止"
    gray_zone: "win rate 50-55% 且 p>0.15 时，以 5 case 定性分析作为 tiebreaker"
    status: BLOCKED

  - plan_id: mvp_judgment
    name: "MVP 综合判定"
    hypothesis: "DTD 方法值得全面研究"
    type: milestone
    dependencies: [mvp_trace_collect, mvp_teacher_scoring, mvp_repair_comparison]
    pass_criteria: "3 个子实验全部 pass"
    kill_criteria: "任一子实验 kill → 终止"
    status: BLOCKED

## 1. Core Thesis

## 3. Story Arc

### Problem
Execution trace 包含丰富的运行时语义（变量状态、控制流路径、异常传播），理论上是程序修复的强信号源。但现有工作的使用方式存在根本性问题：
